title: Tabular Data Synthesis Survey
summary: Code accompanying a survey paper on tabular data synthesis methods, including a custom GMM/copula-based model (SPADA) and an in-tree copy of the CTGAN generative model with its rdt-based data transformer. The repository vendors CTGAN's source (data_transformer.py, ctgan.py) which itself depends on rdt transformers, and separately imports the standalone copulas package for bivariate copula modeling in its custom SPADA model.
evidence: CTGAN./ctgan.py:12-14 imports ctgan.data_sampler/data_transformer/base (vendored CTGAN source); data_transformer.py:8 uses rdt.transformers.ClusterBasedNormalizer
needs: No README present; title and purpose inferred from repo description only. Unclear whether vendored CTGAN/copulas code is actually executed in experiments or just carried as a bundled dependency.
